links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid) and word length of ChatGPT patient education articles versus ACOG articles
links.effect: AI articles had lower Flesch-Kincaid score (mean 46 vs. 59; p<0.0001) and greater average word length (5.3 vs. 4.8), so were harder to read than ACOG materials.
links.quote: Characteristics of the 25 AI-generated articles included fewer overall characters than original articles (mean 3,066 vs. 7,426; p < 0.0001), a greater average word length (mean 5.3 vs. 4.8; p < 0.0001), and a lower Flesch-Kincaid score (mean 46 vs. 59; p < 0.0001).
